source: Kenya Demographic and Health Survey (KDHS) 2022, Kids' Recode (KR) file
source_access: restricted -- obtained via an approved data request to The DHS Program (dhsprogram.com); the raw microdata file is not redistributable and is not committed to this repository
extracted_from: national prevalence read from the annotated reference line in Plots/Vaccination_forest_plot.png (origin/task2-regional-indicators, rendered by Project7_task2.qmd), 2026-08-04.
methodology: Full vaccination defined per the national schedule: BCG, 3-dose OPV + birth dose, 1-dose IPV, 3-dose DPT-HepB-Hib, 3-dose PCV, 2-dose rotavirus, and measles-rubella (1 dose for children 12-23 months, 2 doses for children 24-35 months). Estimates are survey-weighted (v005) and account for the two-stage cluster sample design (primary sampling unit = v021, strata = v022).

national.full_immunisation_prevalence_ci_note: not stated in the recovered source; the forest-plot reference line gives the point estimate only

subnational.status: recovered (12-35 month band), not yet reproduced as a discrete CSV in this branch's own pipeline
subnational.note: No county-level immunisation CSV exists in this repo -- the recovered forest plot / map images are the only county-level view available.
